scope: descriptive only; selected prompts, one RTX 4050, two sessions per profile/budget; ratios are not population estimates

definitions.ms_per_generated_token: method total wall time divided by the configured generation budget
definitions.block_verify_s: runner-reported verification component; total latency remains the end-to-end comparison
definitions.acceptance_rate: total accepted draft tokens divided by total drafted tokens across timing rounds

limitations: Three selected HumanEval development prompts, one GPU, two sessions/profile/budget; timings are descriptive and prompt-selected.
Exactness is relative to each profile’s own experimental singleton B1 state; no cross-profile or BNB state equivalence is established.
GSM8K held-out indices 300-349 were not used.
